_note: Template only — entry and integrity are injected at build/install time (write-plugin-manifest.mjs stamps them into dist/plugin.json). The agent-delegation ergonomics plugin: surfaces `delegate_single` + `delegate_chain` tools that fan a task (or a persona pipeline) out to the agent's `respond` via call_plugin, WITHOUT the agent depending on it. A second instance of the lsp-code-ops pattern (a plugin that EXTENDS the agent). Personas are sovereign `AgentPersona` graph nodes, seeded on setup and readable via query_nodes.
name: Delegate

single.doc: Delegate ONE task to a sub-agent under a named persona (scout, planner, worker, reviewer). The sub-agent runs a full autonomous turn in its own fresh instance + session (nothing pollutes this conversation) and returns its response. Use this to hand a self-contained task to a specialized persona. The available personas are the `AgentPersona` nodes in the graph.

persona.description: The persona to run the task under (e.g. "scout", "planner", "worker", "reviewer"). Resolved to its system prompt + model from the AgentPersona graph nodes. Omit to use the agent's default persona.

task.description: The task/instruction for the sub-agent to carry out.

chain.doc: Delegate a PIPELINE of steps to sub-agents, each under its own persona, run in sequence — each step's output is threaded into the next step's task (substituted for the literal `{previous}`, or appended when there is no marker). Use this for scout→planner→worker→reviewer style workflows. Each step runs in its own fresh instance + session. Returns the final step's response; the whole chain aborts on the first step that fails.

steps.description: The pipeline steps, run in order. Each step's output feeds the next.

persona.description: The persona for this step (resolved from AgentPersona nodes). Omit for the agent default.

task.description: This step's instruction. Use `{previous}` where the prior step's output should be inserted; without it, the prior output is appended as context.
